choice_prompt:8:1141208005.source_cn: 而最高的荣耀只有一种，那便是征战的胜利。所有严苛的族规，都是为胜利而服务。

say:10:1141208007:1.text: I often ask myself, is it truly honorable to trample a defeated enemy and strip them of their dignity?
say:10:1141208007:1.source_cn: 我常常在想，把对手踏在脚下，剥夺对方所有的地位与尊严，...

say:11:1141208008:1.text: Satrana's clan was wiped out, but why can't I befriend this sweet, innocent girl? Who in this world never loses a battle?
say:11:1141208008:1.source_cn: 萨忒娜的氏族败了，但是她单纯、善良，难道她就不能成为我...

say:12:1141208009:1.text: Later, I realized it's up to me to define honor... I'll only do what I believe is right.
say:12:1141208009:1.source_cn: 到后来，我想明白了，荣耀是由我自己来定义的……我会做我...

say:13:1141208010:1.text: So... you don't care what the rest of your clan thinks about you?
say:13:1141208010:1.source_cn: 所以，你不管自己的氏族怎么说？

say:14:1141208011:1.text: They have their opinions, and I have mine. The same blood runs through our veins, but they can't force me to go against my heart and soul.
say:14:1141208011:1.source_cn: 他们有他们的判断，我有我的。我的血永远会与他们交融，但...

say:16:1141208013:1.text: I knew you were strong. An exceptional warrior with a powerful heart.
say:16:1141208013:1.source_cn: 我没看错，你的确很强。不止是力量，还有心灵。
